folds.title: The problem
points: A model only knows what it learned in training, plus what is in front of it.
To answer from your own documents, you must put the right pieces in front of it.

folds.title: Embeddings
points: An **embedding** turns text into a list of numbers that capture its meaning.
So a program can measure how close two texts are.

folds.title: Search by meaning
points: **Found:** a note about a scheduled conference call.
The words differ, but the meaning is close.
folds.note: That is search by meaning, not just matching words.

folds.title: RAG
points: **Retrieve**: find the most relevant pieces of your documents.
**Generate**: give them to the model along with the question.

folds.title: When RAG helps
points: With private or fresh information the model never saw.
It can still go wrong if retrieval misses.
So check important answers against the source.

folds.prompt: Which step is it? Tap the basket.

items.text: Find the notes closest in meaning to the question
items.why: Embeddings are used to find relevant text.

items.text: Write the answer using the notes found
Compare numbers to see which text is nearest
Turn the found notes into a clear reply
